pre_patch_findings.per_session_file_cursor: g_lastFilePos updated after each OnTick read loop — correct for tail-append jsonl within one attach
pre_patch_findings.restart_or_reload_behavior: g_lastFilePos global initializer 0 — OnInit did not seek to EOF, so entire signals_ftmo_demo2.jsonl was re-scanned on every EA (re)start, re-attempting each historical line
pre_patch_findings.signal_id_memory: no in-memory record of processed signal_id — duplicate JSONL lines with same signal_id could be executed multiple times if file cursor rewound or full file replayed
pre_patch_findings.duplicate_log_lines_hypothesis: same signal_id appearing twice in ftmo_bridge_log.jsonl commonly explained by (a) full-file replay after EA reload, or (b) two append operations with identical payload, or (c) two chart instances — not ruled out from code path alone

post_patch_v1_01.tail_mode_on_init: SeedFilePositionToEnd() sets g_lastFilePos to EOF before first tick — avoids historical replay on attach
post_patch_v1_01.session_dedupe: g_seenSignalIds[] — RememberSignalId after EXECUTED or BROKER_REJECT; DUPLICATE_SKIP log when same signal_id seen again
